# Copilot instructions

- Follow `CLAUDE.md` and `.github/skills/java-service-reviewer/SKILL.md`.
- Use Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1.2, Maven, and Google Java Format.
- Preserve the database row lock used to protect daily-limit consumption.
- Keep OpenAPI, RFC 9457 errors, database migrations, and OpenTelemetry traces consistent with code changes.
- Do not add integration tests or dependency scanning; they are excluded by project requirements.
